findings: The handoff preserves the previously accepted fixed five-level signed integer tree, 32 independent R0 restore lanes, 8-lane quantizer, bank/broadcast geometry, atomic credit reservation, return/commit separation, busy c+2 rule, trace cancellation and minimum original-order error rank. No numerical or protocol weakening found.

The minimum nine-file table lists code/config/test artifacts only. An actual implementation package must additionally include source/design.md, source/results.md and rtl/README.md under the isolated C1 root before writing module code, per hardware-agent workspace requirements. This is a required documentation addition, not an ABI expansion.

Q, L_return, F and actual II remain intentionally unmeasured. The executable candidate must choose an explicit finite Q and exact slot widths/ports, distinguish candidate settings from measured latency, and retain atomic reservation so a too-small Q stalls safely rather than overflowing. No symbolic/null Q may be presented as a complete executable implementation.
Independent CPU tests must bind original production or independent integer/bit/R0 logic; they cannot reuse C1 arithmetic/ring/rank helpers as gold. Frozen Scorer/ACT input and gold remain unchanged.

Existing XCI exception flags do not determine subnormal behavior. Actual wrapper finite precision testing is now source-scoped separately; any mismatch is a design issue to resolve without changing R0 or widening tolerance.

The source design remains feasible to prepare while other tools run; new compiled/HLS/RTL identity and actual instance/latency/bank mapping evidence are required for every later claim. v3 OOC cannot establish C1 implementation.
